title: Robust Harmful Meme Detection under Missing Modalities via Shared Representation Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting harmful memes, which involves classifying content based on ethical and moral categories such as hate speech, extremist ideologies, and stereotypes. It specifically benchmarks model performance on identifying 'harmful' versus 'not harmful' content, which is an evaluation of an AI's ability to make moral/ethical judgments regarding social discourse.
